cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The sandwiches are floating. Is gravity late for lunch, or has it resigned? We need a serving plan. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The guests arrive in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Late means plates underneath. Resigned means string on every sandwich. Which are we doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then fetch the deep plates. We may get the whole buffet at once.

mechanism: A directs imminent lunch service and works within B time and supply constraints while making B choose the gravity explanation that governs serving.
confusable: Unlike asserting one magical rule, A makes B select a live competing explanation before assigning the serving plan.
comparison: Plate-catching under temporary gravity absence differs from tiny movers needing full-sized help.
seedUse: D154-b floating sandwiches, late or resigned gravity, string and plates; S02-b adopts B resource-constrained option and shares work.
